contentText:
Stephanie Findlay / Financial Times :

Texas resumes data center permitting, approving permits for SpaceX's $24B gas power plant, ahead of Democratic Governor Gina Hinojosa taking office in January   —  Incoming governor Gina Hinojosa pledged to rein in construction of new projects during her campaign  —  Hello and welcome to Energy Source, coming to you from Houston.
